spans.s:
m. (-हः)
1 Affection, kindness.
2 Oil, unguent, grease, any unctuous or greasy substance.
3 Oiliness, lubricity, viscidity.
E.
ष्णीह to be unctuous, &c., aff. घञ्.

m. (-दः)
Cessation or loss of regard.
E.
स्नेह, and छेद severing.

m. (-हा)
1 A friend.
2 The moon.
3 A disease.
E.
ष्णिह to be affectionate, &c., कनिन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Unctuousness, being or becoming oily, &c.
2 Anointing, unction, rubbing with unguents, oil, &c.
3 An emollient, an unguent, or liniment.
E.
ष्णिह to be unctuous, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-क्वः-क्वा-क्वं)
Dressed with oil.
E.
स्नेह, and पक्व cooked.

m. (-यः)
A lamp.
E.
स्नेह oil, and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-भूः)
The phlegmatic humor.
E.
स्नेह oily substance, and भू born.

m. (-मिः)
1 An object of affection.
2 Any substance yielding oil or grease.
E.
स्नेह, and भूमि site.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Sesamum.
E.
स्नेह oil, रङ्ग colour.

Unctuous, oily.
E.
स्नेह, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-द्धः)
A sort of pine, (Pinus Devadaru.)
E.
स्नेह oil, and विद्ध pierced, impregnated.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Oiled, greased, lubricated.
E.
स्नेह, and अक्त anointed.

f. (-त्तिः)
Affectionate or friendly intercourse.
E.
स्नेह, and अनुवृत्ति practice.

m. (-शः)
A lamp.
E.
स्नेह oil, and अश what consumes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Kind, affectionate.
2 Beloved, the object of affection.
m. (-तः)
A friend.
E.
स्नेह affection, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
1 Affectionate, friendly.
2 Oily, unctuous.
m. (-ही)
1 A friend.
2 A painter.
E.
स्नेह affection, &c., इनि aff.

m. (-हुः)
1 Sickness, disease.
2 The moon.
E.
ष्णिह to be unctuous, उ Uṇādi aff.
